resume.summary: DevOps engineer with 8 years of experience building **cloud infrastructure on AWS and GCP**, automating delivery with **Kubernetes and Terraform**, and keeping production services fast and reliable. Known for cutting release times, lowering cloud costs and making on-call calmer for the whole team.

items.heading: Senior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Moved 40 services from virtual machines to **Kubernetes on EKS**, cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to 6.
Wrote the **Terraform** modules every team now uses for networks, databases and queues, ending hand-made cloud changes.
Lowered the monthly AWS bill by **28%** by rightsizing nodes, adding spot capacity and removing idle resources.
Built release pipelines in **GitHub Actions** with automatic rollback, raising successful deploys to 99.4%.
Introduced service-level objectives and alerting in Prometheus and Grafana, halving pages outside working hours.
Mentored four engineers through their first on-call rotations and wrote the team's incident runbooks.

items.heading: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Containerised the data platform with **Docker** and moved it to GKE, removing three days of manual setup per release.
Set up **GitLab CI** pipelines with tests, image scanning and staged rollouts for 25 repositories.
Automated database backups and restore drills, bringing recovery time for the main database under 20 minutes.
Replaced ad-hoc scripts with **Ansible** roles for 120 servers, keeping configuration consistent across environments.

items.heading: Systems Administrator
bullets: Ran the Linux and VMware estate for 60 stores and the head office with 99.9% availability.
Introduced monitoring with Zabbix, catching disk and network faults before they reached the stores.
Scripted user and access management in Bash and Python, cutting new-starter setup from a day to an hour.

items.heading: Open-source Kubernetes cost reporter
bullets: Built a small Go service that reports cost per namespace from cluster usage and cloud prices.
Used by three companies; reached 900 stars on GitHub.

items.heading: Home-lab GitOps platform
bullets: Ran a self-hosted cluster managed entirely through Git with Argo CD and Helm charts, as a test bed for new tools.

bullets: Thesis: automated deployment of web applications on virtual machines.

paragraphs: I am applying for the **Senior DevOps Engineer** role at Example Employer. Your focus on reliable, well-automated cloud platforms matches the work I enjoy most and have done for the last eight years.

At Northwind Cloud I moved 40 services to **Kubernetes**, cut deployment time from 45 minutes to 6 and lowered the AWS bill by **28%**. Before that I containerised a data platform and built CI pipelines for 25 repositories. I would bring the same habits to your team: infrastructure as code, clear alerts and calm on-call.
Thank you for your time. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can help your platform team, and I am available for an interview at your convenience.
